judgments.reason: The span '2 months after initiation of a new immunotherapy regimen' appears literally in the vignette and clinically supports the immune-related (immunotherapy-induced) etiology of the eosinophilic dermatitis.

The span 'superficial and deep perivascular and interstitial inflammation with numerous eosinophils' appears literally in the biopsy findings section and clinically supports the eosinophilic dermatitis component of the diagnosis, though it more directly supports the eosinophilic dermatitis label than the 'immune-related' modifier specifically; it is nonetheless a reasonable histopathologic support for the completed diagnosis label.
